integrity.source_boundary: The projective-quadric model and switching existence theorem are from arXiv:2610.05189v1; the fundamental-group and path-class consequences are derived here.

scientific_limitations: The classification is for real encoder trajectories inside the nondegenerate indefinite quadric Q_n.
Distinct real path classes may merge when arbitrary complex paths in the larger distance-three set are allowed.
No inequivalence of resulting switching unitaries, holonomies, logical actions, or physical control costs is claimed.
Degenerate quadratic forms and higher-distance families are outside scope.
title: Homotopy classes of real error-transparent code-switching paths
